title: Seven-Stars in Phantom Blade Zero - What the Name Refers To
description: Three different things in Phantom Blade Zero carry the Seven-Stars name: the formation, the Chief Disciple who leads it, and the trophy for beating him. This page routes you to the right one.
keyword: phantom blade zero seven stars, seven-stars formation, sword against the seven-stars, chief disciple

sections.title: The Short Answer
sections.content:
If you searched for “Seven-Stars” you probably want one of three things, and they are not the same page:

  • The fight - Chief Disciple of the Seven-Stars Formation. The boss itself, in the Mandate Encampment.
  • The trophy - Sword Against the Seven-Stars. Silver, awarded for that kill.
  • The formation - the group the Disciple leads. There is no separate page for it, because it is not a separate encounter: the formation is the fight.

sections.title: The Boss
sections.content:
The Chief Disciple of the Seven-Stars is an optional boss in the Mandate Encampment, found mid-region rather than at its end. Guides that place him at a region finale are describing the encampment's story beats, not this fight.

The reason the name reads like a group is that the Seven-Stars are a formation rather than a person, so the encounter is about reading several attackers instead of one. That is the same problem the paired fights pose, and the answer is the same: stay mobile enough that only one of them is ever in range.

Full detail, including the colour tells and the drop, is on the boss page.

sections.title: The Trophy
sections.content:
Sword Against the Seven-Stars is a silver trophy, one of the seventeen that come from a boss kill. It is not missable in the way the side-quest trophies are - the fight stays available - but it is easy to skip entirely on a first run because the boss is optional.

Tier is one of the disputed items on the list: sources agree it is silver and disagree about several of the other boss trophies. See the trophy guide for how that is handled, and the full trophy list for the tier split.

sections.title: Other Names That Get Confused With It
sections.content:
Two near-misses turn up in the same search results, because both are group-named encounters with a single trophy:

  • The Four Great Puppets - four separate fights scattered across regions, one gold trophy. See The Four Freed.
  • The Shadow Wardens - three fights, one bronze trophy, and the same “which one am I missing” problem. See Three Wardens Fall.

sections.title: What This Page Is For
sections.content:
A disambiguation page exists so that three topics do not compete for one URL. Each target above is a normal page with its own content; this one only routes.

If you arrived here looking for the region rather than the boss, the boss list groups every encounter by region, and bosses by class splits them into story and optional.
